J&K Assembly Debates Holidays for Hari Singh, Sheikh Abdullah Anniversaries

A debate occurred in the Jammu and Kashmir assembly on Tuesday regarding public holidays for the anniversaries of Maharaja Hari Singh and Sheikh Mohammad Abdullah. National Conference legislator Abdul Majeed Larmi stated that either both anniversaries should be observed as holidays, as was done previously, or the holiday for Maharaja Hari Singh's birth anniversary should be dropped. The discussion highlighted historical figures and their significance in the region.
